Car Parking Level 7 is a place situated in the middle of Belgium, offering 7 floors of parking spaces. CPL7 offers disabled parking along with lifts on both sides for easy access. The metro offers a connection with other places of the CPL world.

CPL Rules and Information: devforum.roblox.com/t/2580053

💰 Parking Rate: €1 per 1 minute of stay.

🏷️ Keywords: car park, car driving, elevator, lift, queue, express lane
